instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not build any backend endpoints - the user explicitly stated: 'backend istemiyorum frontend geliştir'. Everything is handled in React frontend with rich interactive simulated AI generation in Turkish.
2. Replace/Update /app/frontend/src/index.css to import '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans' and configure the dark theme tokens, holographic conic-gradient animations, and plasma keyframes.

3. Build the Iridescent Holographic Orb component with multi-layered CSS gradients (conic-gradient, radial-gradient, specular highlight, rim glow) and reactive state buttons (Boşta / Dinliyor / Düşünüyor / Konuşuyor) so the orb visibly animates and shifts colors in response.

4. Implement the exact reference layout: Left sidebar rail with circular icon buttons (Home active in vibrant blue), Center glowing hero with Orb + 'Merhaba, Hendricks' + 'Bugün sana nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?', the 'Pro ile daha fazla özelliğin kilidini açın' pill badge, the chat card with 'Dosya İçe Aktar' and 'Araçlar' chips, microphone toggle, and blue circular send button.
5. Implement the 3 quick action cards below: 'Beni Şaşırt!', 'Görsel Oluştur', 'Özet Çıkar' in Turkish with icons and crisp hover states.

6. Clicking on Send or any Quick Action opens or updates the interactive Turkish AI Chat Panel (slide-out from right) with realistic typing animations, generated image cards (e.g. for Görsel Oluştur), code snippets, and summaries.

7. Implement interactive modal dialogs for Pro Upgrade (₺299/ay plan), File Import (with drag-and-drop simulation & preview), Tools selector popover, and Settings dialog (with avatar switcher and voice rate).
8. Ensure every button, input, card, and modal has explicit data-testid attributes matching the list above for complete test coverage.
9. Keep the bottom blue atmosphere glow (CSS radial-gradient) exactly like the Dribbble reference.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. The reference has a distinct midnight-blue void with luminous atmospheric underglow and vibrant holographic refractions.

All copy MUST be in Turkish (TR), naturally translated and culturally intuitive ('Merhaba, Hendricks', 'Bugün sana nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?', 'Beni Şaşırt!', 'Görsel Oluştur', 'Özet Çıkar', 'Pro'ya Yükselt').
Do not use transparent backgrounds under text or dropdown overlays. Always provide solid panels with backdrop blur.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover, focus-visible, and active states with proper transitions.
Use Lucide icons for clean, modern interface symbols.
